home.title: VisaNav — Free, private immigration help
home.description: A free public tool, now in beta, that explains your immigration options in plain language and connects you to recognized nonprofits and pro-bono legal help near you. Personal details are removed from your question in your browser before it's sent. Anonymous, encrypted, no account, no cost, no data sold.
eyebrow: NOT AFFILIATED WITH USCIS OR ICE
home.h1: Immigration is confusing. Getting help shouldn't be.
home.lead: VisaNav answers your immigration questions in plain language, cites official sources, and points you to trustworthy free and low-cost help near you. Ask anonymously, with no account and no cost, and personal details are removed from your question before it's ever sent.

teaser.title: Ask in your own words
teaser.body: No forms, no jargon, no account. Write the way you would tell a friend.
teaser.label: Your question
teaser.placeholder: My work permit expires in three months.

how.title: How VisaNav helps
how.body: Three steps, in plain language, from your first question to real help near you.

steps.title: Ask in your own words
steps.body: Describe your situation in plain language — no forms, no jargon, no account required.

steps.title: Get clear answers with sources
steps.body: VisaNav explains your options and points to official USCIS and government sources you can verify.

steps.title: Find free help near you
steps.body: Connect to recognized nonprofits and pro-bono providers in your state — not to anyone trying to sell you something.

privacy.title: Your privacy comes first
privacy.intro: Immigration questions are personal. Ask a chatbot like ChatGPT directly and your exact words, and who you are, can be stored and tied to you. VisaNav removes personal details in your browser before your question is ever sent, so you can ask freely without wondering where your information goes.

items.title: We remove your personal details first
items.body: Before your message leaves your device, VisaNav removes personal details like A-numbers, receipt numbers, Social Security numbers, emails, phones, addresses and dates, so they never reach our servers or the AI. You'll see exactly what was removed.

items.title: Anonymous by default
items.body: No account required, and we never store your IP address. Ask your questions without signing up or telling us who you are.

items.title: Encrypted, and yours to delete
items.body: Your conversations are encrypted and kept only as long as needed — and you can delete your account and data whenever you want.

items.title: Never sold or shared
items.body: We don't sell your information or use it for advertising. Your questions are used only to answer you — nothing else.
